name: set_camera_at
description: Take a camera by angle ID or displayed number at an explicit group time with native snapping and history. Returns the actual time and end of the affected switch interval.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

angle.description: Stable camera source ID from the live project.

number.description: One-based displayed camera number from the current revision.

occurrence.description: Optional source-backed assembly occurrence from the current revision.

time.description: Exact rational seconds on the multicam group clock.

name: multicam_switch
description: Edit an existing group switch at time. move/apply_suggestion require to, angle requires angle, audio requires source and stream. default_audio restores project routing.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

time.description: Exact rational seconds on the multicam group clock.

to.description: Exact rational seconds on the multicam group clock.

angle.description: Stable camera source ID from the live project.

source.description: Stable ID of a camera or separate audio source.

stream.description: Absolute audio stream index in the indicated source.

name: multicam_source
description: Edit a camera or recorder. rename requires name; offset requires offset; nudge/move require direction; nudge also accepts a group time; microphone sets stream (omit to clear); relink requires an absolute path.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

source.description: Stable ID of a camera or separate audio source.

offset.description: Exact sync offset in rational seconds.

time.description: Group time for the frame or audio sample used by nudge. Omit to use the current group playhead.

stream.description: Absolute audio stream index in the indicated source.

name: multicam_audio
description: Set program audio routing. A fixed master requires a source ID and an absolute audio stream.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

source.description: Stable ID of a camera or separate audio source.

stream.description: Absolute audio stream index in the indicated source.

name: multicam_group
description: Set the group end using time or extend to the last available camera.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

time.description: Exact rational seconds on the multicam group clock.

name: multicam_assembly
description: Edit retained occurrences. append requires group from/to; trim requires occurrence and from or to; move requires occurrence and before; remove requires an explicit occurrence. Removing the last explicit occurrence restores the implicit full group. Selection actions require space, from and to matching the selected range; read those values from multicam_select. Use trim_edge or preview_trim with occurrence, edge and group time for native handle snapping.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

operationID.description: Unique operation ID for this edit. Retry the same request with the same ID.

before.description: Zero-based insertion slot before removal, from 0 through count.

from.description: Exact rational seconds on the group clock for append or trim, or the selected clock for a selection edit.

to.description: Exact rational seconds on the group clock for append or trim, or the selected clock for a selection edit.

time.description: Group time for a snapped trim edge.

name: multicam_select
description: Select a switch at group time, occurrence by index, a range with from/to in the named clock, tool or marks in this window.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

expectedRevision.description: Required when selecting an occurrence from an assembly with still inserts.

time.description: Exact rational seconds on the multicam group clock.

name: multicam_preview
description: Set preview mode or transport. audition takes angle; speed takes a rate; shuttle and step actions take direction; snap takes target.

project.description: Live project handle returned by list_projects.

angle.description: Stable camera source ID from the live project.

time.description: Scrub position in the specified clock, rational seconds.

name: get_multicam
description: Inspect the live group, program audio and reference camera. Page sources with offsets, index issues and stream IDs, switches with overrides, suggested switch boundaries, assembly occurrences, or still placements.
